model: SICAM P850 / P855 power monitoring and PQ device
applies_to: SICAM P850 / P855 (7KG85x) with Modbus TCP or Modbus RTU, firmware V3.11, per communication manual E50417-C1040-C482-B1 (05.2024).
summary: SICAM P850 is a panel power monitoring device and P855 a class A power quality device, both with Ethernet Modbus TCP and an optional RS-485 Modbus RTU interface. All data sits in holding registers: measured values as IEEE floats and energy as floats and doubles. This map covers identity, instantaneous values, THD, flicker, load-profile values, total and per-phase energy and the tariff 1 energy values.

addressing.note: The manual prints 1-based register numbers (0201, 4761...) and states that the address in the message is register number - 1. Register 0201 (voltage a-N) is requested as address 200.

source.title: SICAM Power Monitoring Device and Power Quality Device SICAM P850/P855 7KG85X Communication Manual
source.pages: Modbus TCP/RTU settings pp. 16-18; register numbering p. 18; data types pp. 19-24; registers pp. 25-31 (identity, measured values, flicker), 47-48 (energy float64), 53-56 (load profile, energy float32, tariff float32)

notes: Word order: the manual states that for values larger than one register the lowest register holds the most significant byte (and Modbus TCP data is big-endian), so floats and doubles are high word first (ABCD).

Invalid or overflowed measured values are reported as special floats: 7F800000h = overflow/invalid, 7F800001h = not calculated (e.g. voltage below 15 % of rated), 7F800002h = value does not exist for the network type.

Left out: the indication registers (0101-0152), whose 2-bit value/quality layout is shown only in figures; the date/time registers; PQ aggregation, harmonics, PQ event and tariff counter blocks; the counter-pulse energy registers 0801-0846; tariffs 2-8 float32 and all float64 tariff values; the internal 1-cycle values 0281-0292.
The same register map applies to Modbus TCP and Modbus RTU.

registers.name: Device type
registers.description: Up to 16 characters, e.g. SICAM P.

registers.name: Tariff
registers.description: Read: current tariff; write: tariff from the next measuring period (1-8).

integration.summary: Poll holding registers with FC 03: register 0201 (address 200) onward gives voltages, currents, power, power factor and frequency as big-endian floats; read total active energy import as a double at 4773 (address 4772).
integration.enable: Modbus TCP is configured in the device parameters (standard port 502 fixed, optional user port 503-65535, access rights full or read-only per port). The RS-485 Modbus RTU interface needs the serial option and its own address, baud and parity settings.
integration.watchdog: Communication supervision time (default 600 x 100 ms = 60 s, 0 = off) for both TCP and RTU; Modbus TCP also has a keep-alive time (default 10 s).
quirks: Register numbers are 1-based; subtract 1 for the address.
Floats and doubles are high word first.
Complex values must be read as a whole or the device returns exception 03.
setup: Modbus RTU defaults: address 1, 19200 baud, even parity with 1 stop bit (also odd, none with 1 stop bit, or none with 2 stop bits); baud 1200-115200.
Modbus TCP: up to 4 connections; with a user port, 2 on port 502 and 2 on the user port.
gotchas: A port set to read-only access rejects writes.
Special NaN/Inf floats mark invalid values; handle them before logging.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
